svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "The male reproductive system, side view (front of the body on the left)."], [1, "Sperm are made in the testes and mature in the epididymis."], [3.5, "During ejaculation, sperm travel up the sperm duct, over the ureter and behind the bladder."], [7, "The seminal vesicles and prostate gland add fluids: sperm + fluids = semen."], [10, "Semen leaves through the urethra in the penis."]]
svg.title: Male reproductive system
svg.desc: Side view of the male reproductive system: testis and epididymis in the scrotum, sperm duct, seminal vesicle, prostate gland, urethra and penis, with the bladder and ureter; animation of the path of sperm.
svg.text: Side view, simplified. Front of the body is on the left.

g.data-info: Carries urine from the kidney to the bladder.
Stores urine (part of the excretory system).
Adds a fluid rich in fructose (energy for the sperm) and mucus.
Adds an alkaline fluid that neutralises acid in the urethra and vagina.
Contains erectile tissue; transfers semen into the vagina.
Carries urine from the bladder or semen out of the body (never both at once).
Holds the testes outside the body, about 2–3 °C cooler, the best temperature for making sperm.
Makes sperm in coiled seminiferous tubules (by meiosis) and secretes testosterone.
A long coiled tube where sperm mature and are stored.
Muscular tube that carries sperm from the epididymis, up over the ureter and behind the bladder, to the urethra.
